verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official CLI, IDE integrations, and an API compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, but no first-party Kimi SDK. Using third-party OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs against a compatible API is adjacent protocol compatibility, not an official SDK, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Kimi Code API is compatible with both OpenAI and Anthropic protocols.
